channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 15 Aug: Harare mainly clear · high 18° / low 6°
item.description: Harare: high 18°, low 6° (mainly clear) · Bulawayo: high 17°, low 6° (clear sky) · Mutare: high 18°, low 5° (overcast) · Gweru: high 16°, low 5° (mainly clear) · Masvingo: high 16°, low 7° (overcast) · Victoria Falls: high 24°, low 13° (mainly clear) Tsumo yezuva: Chara chimwe hachitswanyi inda. (One finger cannot crush a louse.) #Zimbabwe #Weather #ZimbabweWeather #ZimbabweNews
